question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses Mr. Cyril Boggis, who is disguised as a spiritual leader, and the correct preposition should relate to his position in the Christian Church.
 
• The appropriate preposition is "**of**" as it denotes affiliation or association with a group or institution, in this case, the Christian Church.
 
• Other options like "off", "oft", and "on" do not correctly express the intended meaning of being part of or associated with the Church.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Apart from the fact that he was at this moment, disguised as a spiritual leader of__ the Christian Church, there was nothing sinister about Mr. Cyril Boggis. He was ...*

 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• **"Off" (से)** is used to indicate separation or removal, which is not fitting for describing affiliation with the Church.
 
• **"Oft" (अक्सर)** is an archaic form of "often" and does not work in this context.
 
• **"On" (पर) **typically expresses location or position, but here it does not convey the idea of association.
